   - From these 3 white carpets, we get 6 white wool.
   - We need 4 more white wool, so craft 1 white carpet using 2 white wool.
   - We need 2 more white wool, so craft another 1 white carpet using 2 white wool.
   - Now we have 8 white carpets, which we can use to craft 8 black carpets.

4. Craft 1 white carpet using 2 white wool.
5. Craft 1 white carpet using 2 white wool.
6. Craft 8 black carpets using 8 white carpet and 1 black dye.

This completes the crafting of the black carpet.
